name: Karei Naru Jinsei - Mina-san no Okage Desu
original_name: 華麗なる人生 みなさんのおかげです
source:
Karei naru Jinsei is a mixture of a board game and a dating simulation with adult content. Up to five players can compete in the board game, represented either by real players or computer AI. The board represents the life of a young male character; the different squares correspond to events that can influence his life and his relationships with the many female characters encountered on the way.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/karei-naru-jinsei-mina-san-no-okage-desu]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《华丽人生》是一款融合桌游、恋爱模拟与成人内容的游戏。最多五名玩家可以参加桌游，既可以由真人扮演，也可以交给电脑AI。棋盘代表一名年轻男性角色的人生，不同格子对应会影响他生活及与沿途遇到的众多女性关系的事件。

[来源：[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/karei-naru-jinsei-mina-san-no-okage-desu]Mobygames[/url]]
